watch.summary: The creator laughs hysterically while watching a Valorant esports broadcast because of how dramatically a coach slammed a giant red timeout button.

beats.what: Creator is watching a Valorant pro match replay.
The clip cuts to a coach slamming a huge red physical button on stage to call a timeout.
Creator notices the absurdly large red button and bursts out laughing.
Creator yells in disbelief about the over-the-top design of the big red button.
Creator questions why they didn't just give the coach a normal small button to press.

watch.author: pro_player_in_footage
watch.why: The creator's high energy and infectious laughter point out a funny stage prop in an esports event that viewers might otherwise ignore. His humorous observation about the unnecessarily dramatic button carries the clip.
